effects: A production game VFX SPRITE ATLAS, 3 columns by 3 rows, exactly NINE independent icons on a truly TRANSPARENT background. Crisp SNES 16-bit pixel art, flat limited palettes, chunky pixels, no blur, no painted lighting. 1024x1024 canvas with nine equal cells. Each effect completely inside its own cell with at least 45 pixels of transparent padding. Row1 left: BLUE ICE CRYSTAL CLUSTER with water bubbles (Mercury). Row1 middle: bright ORANGE FIREBALL RING with orange flames (Mars). Row1 right: zigzag YELLOW GREEN LIGHTNING BOLT (Jupiter). Row2 left: GOLDEN CHAIN OF THREE HEART LINKS stretched horizontally (Venus). Row2 middle: PINK HEART with white star glint (Chibi Moon). Row2 right: golden EARTH ENERGY SPHERE with orbit ring (Uranus). Row3 left: turquoise OCEAN WAVE SPHERE (Neptune). Row3 middle: purple MAGENTA ENERGY SPHERE with rings (Pluto). Row3 right: large violet CRESCENT SLASH (Saturn). No characters, no labels, no text, no cell borders, no floor shadows, no backdrop. Consistent sharply stepped pixel edges. The icons are individual magical projectiles for a side-scrolling pixel game.
